thread:
Maria Gonzalez: Heads-up — PM asked for a single-pane dashboard that shows cost per 1k tokens + a breakdown of where savings are coming from (KV cache, batching, quantization). Need infra + runtime ingest spec and a quick console mock for rollout UX.

AJ Singh: SGTM. Can we lock metric names and tags first? We should avoid ad-hoc fields.

Kevin Choi: Proposed minimal telemetry contract:

AJ Singh: +1 to minimal. Kevin, drop a tiny example we can copy into runtime emitters.

Kevin Choi: ```
# metrics proto (conceptual)
metric: unit_cost_usd_per_1k_tokens
value: float
labels: [model_name, model_variant, region, deployment_tier, route_policy, workspace_id, customer_tier]
meta: {cache_hit_rate, batch_avg_tokens, quant_mode}
```

Lina Park: For console widgets we'll need both absolute and delta views (current vs baseline rollout). Also a toggle to show per-workspace vs aggregated. Mocking up in Figma today.

Samir Rao: On runtime side, two asks: 1) tag every request with route_policy and workspace_id 2) emit per-response token counts + cache hit bool so we can compute savings.

AJ Singh: For quotas dashboards we also want quota dimensions: quota_type (token_quota, req_quota), quota_window (monthly/rolling30d), enforcement_level (soft, hard).

Kevin Choi: Runtime can emit these with an atomic event:
```
emit_event(\"inference.complete\", {
  tokens: 534,
  cost_estimate_usd: 0.00074,
  cache_hit: false,
  route: \"prefers-low-latency\",
  model: \"rw-7b-v2\",
  workspace_id: \"ws_123\",
})
```
Then ingest can transform into the metric unit.

Maria Gonzalez: Nice. Need doc for mapping from events -> dashboard metrics. Add a small ER diagram? Keep it simple for SRE/Platform handoff.

AJ Singh: I can draft the ingest contract in the metrics repo. TL;DR for ingestion: accept events, compute per-request cost, rollup into per-1k-token bucket, store exposure tags.

Lina Park: UX ask: when a rollout toggles quantization, show expected delta in unit cost and predicted quality regression (from eval sets) side-by-side. That'll help PMs decide.

Samir Rao: One implementation detail: batching skew. We should record batch_id and batch_size for each inference so we can credit savings to batching correctly.

Kevin Choi: Agreed. Suggest labels: batch_size:int, batch_avg_tokens:int, batch_id:uuid. Keep batch_id sampled for high-throughput to avoid cardinality explosion.

AJ Singh: Cardinality note logged. We'll sample batch_id at 1% for high-volume customers and 100% for enterprise workspaces.

Maria Gonzalez: Owners?

AJ Singh: I'll own ingest schema + gating for quotas.

Kevin Choi: I'll add runtime emitters and a small PR to the SDK.

Lina Park: I'll push console mock + a simple MVP layout (cost per 1k, cache savings bar, batch savings stack, quota health).

Samir Rao: I'll update runtime tags and add sampling knobs.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline: metrics-ingest-contracts branch built — CI passed — staging deploy queued.

Maria Gonzalez: Great. Can we sync tomorrow 11am? Need to align on rollout UX before we show PM.

AJ Singh: 11am works for me.

Kevin Choi: Works.

Lina Park: Works, adding calendar.

Samir Rao: Adding calendar.

Maria Gonzalez: Action items summary: 1) AJ draft ingest contract PR 2) Kevin add emitter + sampling 3) Samir add runtime tags + batch sampling 4) Lina console mock 5) Maria coordinate PM preview. I'll paste a link to the PR checklist in the thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
